_about: Experiments group eval runs that ran the same way on the same tasks, so the viewer can rank them side by side. A run not listed under any experiment's `runs` joins one by the default rule in viewer/explore.py: agent runs to agent-holdout, one-reply runs on the paperwork to one-reply-docs, the rest to one-reply-text. `notes` label a run in the leaderboard.

agent-holdout.title: Agent on the holdout tasks
agent-holdout.description: Harbor's terminus-2 agent works in an offline container with the household's PDFs, pdftotext and benefits-calc, and writes /app/answer.json. Up to 40 turns and 30 minutes per task. The fine-tuned models land here next to the base model.

one-reply-docs.title: One reply, from the paperwork
one-reply-docs.description: The model reads the household's documents as text in one prompt and answers in one reply. No tools.

one-reply-text.title: One reply, from a written summary
one-reply-text.description: The model reads a clean written summary of the household and answers in one reply. No documents, no tools.

notes.20261102-0558-harbor-qwen3-4b-instruct: base model, first run: 276 of 400 tasks
